description: Odisha is set to bring Artificial Intelligence (AI) into the curriculum for undergraduate and postgraduate students to mark a new focus on skills alongside academic degrees.
body_lead: Odisha is set to bring Artificial Intelligence (AI) into the curriculum for undergraduate and postgraduate students to mark a new focus on skills alongside academic degrees. The initiative is part of the Higher Education Department’s masterplan to make students globally competitive and better equipped for the digital age. Three Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) have been signed between the Higher Education Department, CSR Box, Nandi Foundation, OKCL and NASSCOM to promote AI-based learning and skill development.
